decision: Accept that the learned record-conditioned gate materially contributes to r20, but do not promote the r20 checkpoint because its complete-time Marmousi gate failed.
mechanism_nuance: The gate improved early, middle, late, and all three family time-domain metrics, but did not improve the middle/high spectrum-relative-L2 summaries. Its benefit is therefore consistent with record-specific cross-frequency interference reweighting, not direct recovery of missing high-frequency coefficient accuracy.
next_action: Do not tune another multiplicative gate variant. Check existing disjoint-train evidence for this WKB mapper family; if absent, measure same-protocol train-only generalization before any validation access.
